glosses: to froth (to create froth in a liquid)
to foam (to form or emit foam)
to foam at the mouth (to rage, to vent one's anger)

examples.text: Wpadł zatem do nas któregoś dnia i pieniąc się z gniewu zaczął krzyczeć do Majstra: Co to jest!

glosses: detto generalmente di cavalli e altri animali, produrre schiuma colla saliva, sbavare
fig., essere talmente arrabbiati da perdere saliva
